description: NaCaTiMnSi₂O₈F is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form distorted NaO₄F₂ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one TiO₆ octahedra, corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄F₂ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent MnO₅F octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 66°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.54 Å. There is one shorter (2.26 Å) and one longer (2.38 Å) Na-F bond length. Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven O and one F atom. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.82 Å. The Ca-F bond length is 2.23 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted TiO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MnO₅F octahedra, corners with five SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄F₂ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MnO₅F octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-66°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-2.35 Å. Mn is bonded to five O and one F atom to form MnO₅F octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one TiO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one MnO₅F octahedra, and edges with three equivalent NaO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-54°. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.34 Å. The Mn-F bond length is 2.23 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MnO₅F octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with three equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-78°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.66 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MnO₅F octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-73°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.66 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Ti, and two equivalent Mn atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Ca, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Ca, one Ti, one Mn, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Ti, one Mn, and one Si atom to form distorted ONaTiMnSi trigonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent FNa₂CaMn tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Ca, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Ca and two Si atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Mn, and one Si atom. F is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one Mn atom to form FNa₂CaMn tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent ONaTiMnSi trigonal pyramids and  an edgeedge with one FNa₂CaMn tetrahedra.
